cases.brief:
layer: api
issue: #12 (#10/AC-1: POST /charges with a card token and an amount returns 201 and the payment id. #10/AC-2: when the payment gateway fails, the client gets 502 and the gateway's error message in the response body, so our support team can see exactly what the provider said)
branch: feat/12-charge-api
base: main
scenario: Given a payment gateway that rejects the card, when the client posts a charge, then the client gets 502 and sees what the provider said
round: 1
Notes: the API is a plain function handle_charge(body: dict, gateway: PaymentGateway) -> tuple[int, dict] in the payments package; the domain (payments/domain.py) is already merged on main. Use only the standard library.

layer: use-cases
issue: #22 (#20/AC-1: cancelling a placed order through the CancelOrder use case saves it as cancelled in the order store. #20/AC-2: cancelling an order the store does not have fails with a not-found result)
branch: feat/22-cancel-order-use-case
base: main
scenario: Given a placed order in the store, when the customer cancels it, then the store holds it as cancelled
round: 1
Notes: the domain (src/orders/order.ts) is on main. No dependencies may be installed; tests run with `node --test`.

files.docs/wireframes/cart.md:
# Cart wireframe

Approved by: the design owner, 2026-11-10.

States: empty, populated, checking-out, checkout-failed.

- checkout-failed: the cart stays as it was; a banner reads "We couldn't complete your order. Try again." with a Retry button and a small reference code below it.
files.src/cart/api.ts: export interface CheckoutApi { checkout(cartId: string): Promise<{ orderId: string }>; }

cases.brief:
layer: state
issue: #92 (#90/AC-1: a failed checkout keeps the cart as it was. #90/AC-2: after a failed checkout the cart state carries the message to show, which should be the API's error message so the user knows exactly what went wrong)
branch: feat/92-cart-state
base: main
wireframe: docs/wireframes/cart.md, approved by the design owner on 2026-11-10; skeleton: e2e/cart.spec.ts
scenario: Given a cart, when checkout fails, then the cart is kept and the error offers a retry
round: 1
Notes: the state is a plain TypeScript module in src/cart using the CheckoutApi port in src/cart/api.ts. No dependencies may be installed; tests run with `node --test`.
